message.content: {"B_expression":"-1/(2*(1+u)**3*(sqrt(1+r/(1+u)**2)+1)**2)","C_expression":"-1/(2*(1+u))","derivation":"Retain the P06_W0 program unchanged. Algebra: setting s=sqrt(1+r/(1+u)^2), the exact increment is g*=r/((1+u)(s+1)). Expanding g* in r gives g*=r/2 - u*r/(2(1+u)) - r^2/(2(1+u)^3(s+1)^2)+O(r^3), identifying C=-1/(2(1+u)) and B=-1/(2(1+u)^3(s+1)^2). The numeric feedback confirms machine-epsilon residuals (~1e-71) for all UNIFORM rows inside the chi support at both t=1/64 and t=1/512. Rows with |u|>1/4 (e.g. LEFT x=1/64 s=0 with z=-31, u=-32) correctly receive only the bare r/2 because chi_u=0 there. Smoothness on an open neighbourhood of the closed rectangle |r|<=1/2, |u|<=1/4 holds because 1+u>=3/4 and 1+r/(1+u)^2>=1/9>0 throughout.
